plan.title: Publish apps/kanban to GitHub Packages
plan.overview: Configure the apps/kanban package for GitHub Packages publishing by updating package.json with the scoped name @mattfletcher94/claudeban, adding publishConfig pointing to npm.pkg.github.com, and creating a kanban:publish script using pnpm workspace filtering. This follows the existing pnpm workspace patterns at package.json:12-15 for consistency.

approach.rationale:
GitHub Packages requires scoped package names matching the GitHub username/org. The package will be renamed from "claude-kanban" to "@mattfletcher94/claudeban" to match the repository owner. Using publishConfig.registry ensures npm publish targets GitHub Packages without requiring a global .npmrc override.
The prepublishOnly script ensures the build runs before every publish, preventing accidental publishing of stale artifacts. This is standard npm practice.
The kanban:publish script uses pnpm --filter pattern (established at package.json:12-15) for workspace consistency. Publishing requires running from package directory, so the script uses pnpm --filter to target the package correctly.

change.affects: apps/kanban/package.json (name field), apps/kanban/bin/install.cjs (PACKAGE_NAME constant, help text)

task.name: Update apps/kanban/package.json for GitHub Packages
task.action:
- Change "name" from "claude-kanban" to "@mattfletcher94/claudeban" (line 2) - Change repository.url from "https://github.com/mattfletcher94/claude-kanban" to "https://github.com/mattfletcher94/claudeban" (line 32) - Add publishConfig object after repository block: ```json "publishConfig": { "registry": "https://npm.pkg.github.com", "access": "restricted" }, ``` - Add prepublishOnly script to scripts block: ```json "prepublishOnly": "pnpm build" ```
Current code (apps/kanban/package.json lines 1-5): ```json { "name": "claude-kanban", "version": "1.0.0", "description": "A kanban-style task management system..." ```
Change to: ```json { "name": "@mattfletcher94/claudeban", "version": "1.0.0", "description": "A kanban-style task management system..." ```
Current code (lines 30-33): ```json "repository": { "type": "git", "url": "https://github.com/mattfletcher94/claude-kanban" }, ```
Change to: ```json "repository": { "type": "git", "url": "https://github.com/mattfletcher94/claudeban" }, "publishConfig": { "registry": "https://npm.pkg.github.com", "access": "restricted" }, ```
task.verify: node -e "const p=require('./apps/kanban/package.json'); console.log(p.name, p.publishConfig?.registry, p.scripts?.prepublishOnly)" | grep "@mattfletcher94/claudeban https://npm.pkg.github.com pnpm build"
task.done: package.json has scoped name, correct repository URL, publishConfig with GitHub registry, and prepublishOnly script

task.name: Update PACKAGE_NAME in install.cjs
task.action:
- Change PACKAGE_NAME constant from 'claude-kanban' to '@mattfletcher94/claudeban' (line 13)
Current code (line 13): ```javascript const PACKAGE_NAME = 'claude-kanban'; ```
Change to: ```javascript const PACKAGE_NAME = '@mattfletcher94/claudeban'; ```
The help text (line 116) and other references use PACKAGE_NAME constant, so they will automatically reflect the new name.
task.done: PACKAGE_NAME constant updated, help text shows correct npx command

task.name: Add kanban:publish script to root package.json
task.action:
- Add "kanban:publish" script using pnpm --filter pattern (consistent with kanban:build at line 12) - Place after existing vscode:install script (line 15)
Current code (lines 12-16): ```json "kanban:build": "pnpm --filter claude-kanban build", "vscode:watch": "pnpm --filter claude-kanban-vscode watch", "vscode:package": "pnpm --filter claude-kanban-vscode package", "vscode:install": "pnpm vscode:package && code --install-extension apps/vscode/claude-kanban-vscode-0.1.0.vsix" ```
Change to: ```json "kanban:build": "pnpm --filter @mattfletcher94/claudeban build", "kanban:publish": "pnpm --filter @mattfletcher94/claudeban publish --no-git-checks", "vscode:watch": "pnpm --filter claude-kanban-vscode watch", "vscode:package": "pnpm --filter claude-kanban-vscode package", "vscode:install": "pnpm vscode:package && code --install-extension apps/vscode/claude-kanban-vscode-0.1.0.vsix" ```
Note: --no-git-checks allows publishing from any branch/state (pnpm default requires clean git state). Also update kanban:build filter to use new package name.
task.done: Root package.json has kanban:publish script using pnpm workspace filter pattern

task.name: Create .npmrc.template for authentication documentation
task.action:
- Create template file documenting GitHub Packages authentication setup - Include instructions for creating PAT with read:packages scope - Show exact .npmrc configuration format
Create apps/kanban/.npmrc.template: ``` # GitHub Packages Authentication # # To install @mattfletcher94/claudeban from GitHub Packages: # # 1. Create a Personal Access Token (PAT) at https://github.com/settings/tokens # - Select "read:packages" scope for installation # - Select "write:packages" scope if you need to publish # # 2. Add these lines to your ~/.npmrc (NOT project .npmrc): # //npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=YOUR_GITHUB_PAT @mattfletcher94:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com # # 3. Now you can install: # npx @mattfletcher94/claudeban # # Note: The package is private. Only users with read access to the # mattfletcher94/claudeban repository can install it. ```
task.done: .npmrc.template exists with GitHub Packages authentication instructions

task.name: Verify build still works with new package name
task.action: - Run the build to ensure package name changes don't break anything - Verify pnpm can resolve the new package name in workspace
task.done: Build completes successfully with new package name
